name: Emergency Plumbing
short_desc: 24/7 emergency plumbing for burst pipes, active leaks, overflowing fixtures, sewer backups, and urgent repairs.
long_desc: Call Masterflow for active water, sewage backups, failed shutoffs, burst pipes, or no hot water. A plumber checks the affected fixture or line, explains the repair, and gives you upfront pricing before work starts. Same-day service is available.

name: Drain Cleaning
short_desc: Professional drain cleaning for kitchen, bathroom, laundry, and main sewer line clogs.
long_desc: Drain cleaning can involve one fixture, a shared branch, or the main sewer line. Masterflow checks which drains are affected, how the line responds, where cleanouts are located, and whether cable work, camera inspection, or hydro jetting fits the condition.

name: Hydro Jetting
short_desc: Clear grease, roots, sludge, and heavy buildup with professional hydro jetting.
long_desc: Hydro jetting uses high-pressure water to remove grease, sludge, roots, and buildup from drain and sewer lines. Pipe condition, access, prior repairs, camera findings, and safe discharge all matter before jetting is recommended.

name: Water Heater Services
short_desc: Repair, replacement, and installation for tank and tankless water heaters.
long_desc: Water-heater service begins with the unit type, age, leak location, fuel or electrical supply, venting, controls, and the property's hot-water demand. Those findings help separate a serviceable component from a tank or system that should be replaced.

name: Sewer Line Repair
short_desc: Camera inspections, sewer access, trenchless preparation, targeted repair, and sewer line replacement.
long_desc: Sewer work should begin with evidence about the line, failure, depth, access, branches, and prior repairs. Depending on those conditions, Masterflow may clean the line, prepare it for epoxy lining, support trenchless work, reopen branch tie-ins with robotic cutting, repair a section, or plan replacement.

name: Leak Detection
short_desc: Visible and hidden leak checks for walls, slabs, fixtures, valves, and service lines.
long_desc: Leak detection narrows the likely source before walls, floors, or concrete are opened. Meter movement, fixture behavior, valves, pressure, sound, heat, moisture, accessible piping, and the property layout all help determine the next inspection or repair step.

name: Slab Leak Repair
short_desc: Slab leak investigation and repair planning for Southern California homes.
long_desc: A suspected slab leak needs careful investigation because the visible symptom may not sit directly over the failed pipe. Masterflow considers meter movement, hot and cold behavior, pressure, sound, moisture, accessible piping, and the home layout before comparing direct access, rerouting, targeted replacement, or broader repiping.

name: Repiping
short_desc: Whole-home and targeted pipe replacement for aging or failing plumbing systems.
long_desc: Repiping is a larger project for homes with repeated leaks, pressure problems, aging materials, corrosion, or remodel needs. It replaces part or all of the water-distribution system rather than repairing one fixture. A good repipe plan covers access, shutoffs, fixture count, wall openings, scheduling, material choice, inspections, and how to keep the home livable while the work is completed.

name: Gas Line Services
short_desc: Gas line checks, repairs, and appliance connection support where licensed plumbing service is needed.
long_desc: Gas odor or a suspected active leak requires leaving the area and following utility emergency instructions first. After the immediate hazard is cleared, Masterflow can review shutoffs, appliance connections, damaged lines, routing, testing, permits, and the licensed plumbing work required.

name: Fixture Install & Repair
short_desc: Faucets, toilets, disposals, showers, valves, shutoffs, sinks, pumps, and everyday fixture repairs.
long_desc: Fixture repair and installation covers the plumbing customers use every day. Masterflow handles faucets, toilets, sinks, showers, bathtubs, garbage disposals, shutoff valves, supply lines, cartridges, hot-water recirculation pumps, sump pumps, backflow preventers, and small fixture upgrades. The repair includes the visible fixture and the connections, seals, valves, drains, and supports that make it work.
